integrity: The nontrivial all-response strictness is supported by an explicit Poisson add-one gap-splitting argument. Scalar low moments and finite-chain non-Gaussianity are credited to prior work; exact symbolic checks supplement rather than replace proof. No independent audit or formal certification has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Stable finite-dimensional linear systems with mutually independent Poisson resetting Brownian reservoirs and at least one nonzero reservoir-to-observable impulse response; not an infinite-network, nonlinear, or correlated-clock claim. General mixture theorems may implicitly cover part of this result.
title: Strict fourth-cumulant positivity for finite linear networks driven by Brownian reset reservoirs
